nom: Hanskin Vitamin C Glow Powder Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including some with enlarged pores, report the cleanser deep-cleans and minimizes pores without over-drying, and one very oily/reactive reviewer says it cleanses thoroughly without breakouts or barrier damage.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the powder cleans well but several note tightness or flakiness at first, while others say it left skin soft and hydrated rather than stripped.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin (including combination-acne-prone) report it did not suit one user's skin, causing irritation, while others found it gentle, tightening-looking pores and leaving skin soft.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive or reactive skin mostly report the cleanser is gentle, fragrance-free, and non-irritating, though two reviewers who suspect a vitamin C sensitivity report redness and itching that resolved on stopping use.
segments.mature: One reviewer with aged/mature skin reports it cleans effectively three times a week without stripping.

concerns.aging: The one reviewer identifying mature skin reports effective, non-stripping cleansing with regular but not daily use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the cleanser leaves skin soft, refreshed and not tight or stripped; a minority (dry or first-time users) report initial tightness, flakiness or dryness before adjusting use.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness and calmer skin over time, including one with acne-related redness; two reviewers who suspect a vitamin C reaction report new facial redness and itching that subsided once they stopped using it.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe it as not stripping natural oils or damaging the moisture barrier, with one specifically contrasting it favorably to harsher exfoliants like Dermalogica Superfoliant.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, and post-acne marks after two to three weeks of use; no dissenting reports on this point.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin report fewer breakouts, calmer skin, and reduced blackhead appearance over time; one reviewer reports no change in breakouts either way.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser controls oil and minimizes pore appearance without causing excess dryness.

aspects.libelle: Good value, lasts a long time

extraits.titre: I would not purchase again...here are my thoughts...
extraits.texte: I have mixed feelings over this product and I'll elaborate some more. I have combination and acne-prone skin and was looking forward to using this product. The product was travel friendly and the idea was good, but my skin did not agree with it. I liked that when you added warm water, it foamed really nicely, but I did not like the smell. It was almost like plastic and chemicals which was definitely not the best sensorial experience. After a week or two of use, I noticed that my skin became really irritated and red (itchy). It felt like I had a large reaction that dwindled down after some time passed. Normally, my skin does not behave like this, so I decided to remove this product from my routine and the redness was gone. I identified this product of being the root of the cause and think that I might have a Vitamin C reaction in general. If you are looking to buy this product, look into it some more and make sure you don't have reactions to Vitamin C. Note that this product is definitely not a product that you should be dependent on for receiving Vitamin C because you would not receive a lot of benefits from this. Overall, it was okay, but I personally will not be purchasing again.

I love that it's powder but for my skin I found it very harsh. It dried out my skin and over time my face became flaky. There is another company that I tried that is powder form and it was extremely hydrating. But I wanted to try a Korean brand. Disappointed. Maybe better for less sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: This has been a great product for my skin!
extraits.texte: My skin is glowing and very even toned! I have acne prone skin that's also slightly oily and after using this for roughly 2-3 weeks, I noticed my skin was brighter and softer, dark spots were slowly fading away. I'm about to buy my second bottle!

I stumbled upon this product one day and I am so glad I did. It is the perfect second-step cleanser! I have acne-prone skin so I tend to be sensitive to new products, but this made my skin noticeably softer and helps with redness. My skin used to get horribly red when I broke out but with this product, it is much calmer. The gentle exfoliation is perfect and it is awesome to use after a pre-cleanse. I would absolutely recommend this!

extraits.titre: Love this, substitute for Dermalogica Microfoliant
extraits.texte: Wow, this is such a perfect gentle cleanser! I have incredibly reactive skin, and I'm oily enough that I can't use most products for "sensitive" skin. This cleanser takes care of me: clean enough that my skin is fresh and doesn't break out, but it doesn't ruin my skin barrier the way harsher cleansers do. Takes off most makeup (not waterproof eye makeup but I use remover for that). Gentle exfoliation from the particles -- it's a substitute for Microfoliant, although it doesn't have the enzymes (which some people are allergic to btw). Also, because it's a powder, you're not paying for water and a little goes a long way. It takes a very long time to finish the container, even used all-over --not just face -- twice a day!
Very gentle powder cleanser. I use this 3 times per week. It lathers nicely and I feel it's very effective in cleaning without stripping my aged skin. I love it and would repurchase.

I've never tried powder cleanser before but I like this Glow Powder Cleanser. You don't need a lot and it dissolves quickly in water. Not sure how exfoliating it is but my main concern was that it be gentle on my face which is currently going through a sensitive bout (I blame both mask-wearing and menopause). It is very gentle; my face did not react badly to it. My skin also doesn't feel dry or tight after using it. Label says no artificial fragrance but the natural scent of the powder took a little getting used to; not enough to be a deal breaker. I'm definitely looking forward to seeing results from long-term use.
